$comment: largen's approved-component allowlist. This ships covering the reference components; a project replaces the `components` array with its own. `largen gen` regenerates schema.json, prompt.md and manifest.js from this file.

tone.description: Semantic colour. Inherits — set it on a container to re-tone everything inside.

variant.description: How the tone is applied as a fill. Derived from the tone, never a separate colour. Applies to the element it is on.

size.description: One multiplier scaling type, padding and gap. Inherits.

notes: State (disabled, invalid, checked, read-only) is NOT settable here. It comes from the DOM and from real HTML attributes.
There is no field for a colour, a class, or inline CSS. The safety property is structural, not defensive: the worst a compromised model can do is pick the wrong approved component.

components.name: alert
components.for: A message reporting a state. Use with a tone.

components.name: badge
components.for: A short inline label or count.

components.name: dot
components.for: A bare status dot. No content.

components.name: spinner
components.for: An indeterminate activity indicator.

components.name: skeleton
components.for: A loading placeholder occupying a future element's box.

components.name: card
components.for: A container grouping related content on a surface.

components.name: panel
components.for: A surface with no border.

components.name: divider
components.for: A labelled or bare horizontal rule.

components.name: stat
components.for: A figure with a label. Wraps stat-label and stat-value.

components.name: stat-label
components.for: The label above a figure.

components.name: stat-value
components.for: The figure itself. Renders tabular-nums.

components.name: menu
components.for: A vertical list of navigation or action items.

components.name: crumbs
components.for: An ancestry trail.

components.name: steps
components.for: A numbered sequence. Mark position with aria-current.

components.name: bubble
components.for: A conversation bubble. data-side="end" for the user's own turn.

components.name: avatar
components.for: A person's image or initials.

components.name: tip
components.for: Wraps a child; hint text goes in data-tip.

components.name: prose
components.for: Long-form rendered text. Wrap markdown output in this.

components.name: stack
components.for: Vertical layout. Set --gap.

components.name: row
components.for: Horizontal layout, no wrap.

components.name: cluster
components.for: Horizontal layout that wraps. Tag lists, icon groups.

components.name: grid
components.for: As many columns as fit at --min-item.

components.name: center
components.for: Constrained measure, centred.
